verdicts.why: The check asserts that only the newly issued credential remains live, the prior credential was revoked by the administrator, and the prior secret and its existing session are rejected; repeated re-issues also retain exactly one live credential. It injects failure at the audit append, compares complete table dumps for equality, and verifies the previously live secret and session remain valid after rollback.
